races.blurb: President of the United States, Nov. 5, 2024 general election. Harris/Walz (D) and Trump/Vance (R) are shown directly; Kennedy (American), Stein (Green), Oliver (Libertarian), de la Cruz (Peace and Freedom), and write-ins are combined into “Other.”

races.label: President
races.blurb: President of the United States, Nov. 3, 2020 general election. Biden/Harris (D) and Trump/Pence (R) are shown directly; Jorgensen (Libertarian), Hawkins (Green), La Riva (Peace and Freedom), and De La Fuente (American Independent) are combined into “Other.” Results were reported by 2020 precinct and are allocated to the current map, so individual units are estimates.
